name: Archetype:Earth
original_name: 真祖 アルクェイド
source:
The awakened, true form of Arcueid Brunestud. She represents the Earth’s consciousness and will, transcending her identity as a True Ancestor to become “Type Earth”—the planet’s ultimate defense mechanism and avatar. Arche-Type Earth embodies the full potential of the world’s energy, standing as one of the most powerful beings in the Nasuverse, equivalent to other celestial entities that protect their respective planets.

In this form, Arcueid’s appearance and abilities change dramatically. As Arche-Type Earth, she has access to nearly limitless regenerative powers, reality manipulation, and immunity to mortal limitations, embodying the Earth’s immense willpower. This transformation is rare and appears only when the planet itself is in grave danger, making her a near-unstoppable force.
